summary.text: Charles Dudley is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Bob Brinson (R).
He was the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Charles Dudley lost the Democratic primary for North Carolina House of Representatives District 3 to Barbara Lee on May 8, 2018.
In the 2018 Ballotpedia candidate survey, he named education, a living wage and affordable health care as his top three priorities.
In 2024 he won the Democratic primary for North Carolina State Senate District 3 and lost the general election to incumbent Bob Brinson (R), 60.0% to 40.0%.
He advanced to the 2026 general election after the Democratic primary was canceled.
